frames.goal: Reach the next truthful local state without fabricated library or playback information.
frames.primary: Wait; no repeated action while routing is active.
frames.entry: Cold or warm app start.
frames.exit: Verified pending onboarding, permission recovery, or Home/Library state.
frames.back: System Back exits the launch task; no in-app Back control.
frames.truth: Verified local migration/readiness and platform state.
frames.recovery: A bounded failure changes to the migration-error frame with Retry.
frames.persistence: No UI-owned playback or library state is persisted.
frames.talkback: App name → Loading status.
frames.system: System splash/status chrome remains Android-owned.

frames.goal: Recover startup without clearing valid local data.
frames.primary: Retry startup once the user explicitly chooses Retry.
frames.entry: Typed startup or local migration failure.
frames.exit: Successful Retry routes from freshly verified state.
frames.back: System Back exits; Retry never traps focus.
frames.truth: Local migration result; no fabricated Empty/Ready state.
frames.recovery: Retry; repeated failure remains concise and non-destructive.
frames.persistence: Verified prior data is retained; no reinstall/clear-data default.
frames.talkback: Error heading → explanation → Retry.
frames.system: No Android Settings handoff is implied.

frames.goal: Understand that Music Copilot plays local device music without an account.
frames.primary: Continue to Slide 2.
frames.entry: First run or explicit replay.
frames.exit: Slide 2 / Skip Voice education.
frames.back: Back exits or returns according to the owning first-run route without mutating completion.
frames.truth: Static approved product education.
frames.recovery: Interrupted onboarding resumes the actual pending step.
frames.persistence: Completion is stored only after Continue/Skip reaches its committed step.
frames.talkback: Heading → explanation → page position → Continue.
frames.system: No permission is requested on this slide.

frames.goal: Understand optional Voice and retain full manual control when it is skipped.
frames.primary: Finish; optional Practice Voice is a separate explicit action.
frames.entry: Continue from Slide 1 or resume pending education.
frames.exit: Permission/library readiness path; Skip/Finish requests no microphone.
frames.back: Back returns to Slide 1 without changing permission or playback.
frames.truth: Exactly six supported intents; Voice provider/permission remains unrequested until explicit practice.
frames.recovery: Skip or provider decline returns to manual local control.
frames.persistence: Education completion only; permission/provider state is re-read separately.
frames.talkback: Heading → six-command summary → page position → Practice Voice → Finish without Voice.
frames.system: Microphone dialog may occur only after explicit Practice Voice.

frames.goal: Understand one capability purpose before an Android permission request.
frames.primary: Continue to the Android-owned permission dialog.
frames.entry: Media access is first required, or mic is explicitly tapped/practiced.
frames.exit: Android dialog handoff; return routes to Granted/Denied.
frames.back: Back/Not now returns to a usable manual surface.
frames.truth: Android permission state is authoritative.
frames.recovery: Not now preserves manual controls; no coercive loop.
frames.persistence: The app does not persist a false permission result.
frames.talkback: Permission heading → purpose → Continue → Not now → system-boundary note.
frames.system: [ANDROID / SYSTEM] dialog is not an app screen.

frames.goal: Resume the exact action that was blocked by the capability check.
frames.primary: Continue automatically or explicitly to the blocked app action.
frames.entry: Android reports Granted after request or Settings return.
frames.exit: Media grant → scan/readiness; mic grant → provider/capability check.
frames.back: Back returns to the initiating surface.
frames.truth: Fresh Android permission recheck.
frames.recovery: If capability changes before use, re-enter the appropriate recovery state.
frames.persistence: Platform truth is re-read; grant is not copied as permanent app truth.
frames.talkback: Granted status → next action.
frames.system: Provider availability/cloud consent remains distinct from microphone grant.

frames.goal: Recover or continue manually after a requestable denial.
frames.primary: Try again; Not now remains equally reachable.
frames.entry: Android denies while another request remains permitted.
frames.exit: Try again → rationale/request; Not now → initiating manual surface.
frames.back: Same as Not now; no automatic Settings launch.
frames.truth: Fresh Android permission result.
frames.recovery: Retry or manual fallback; local browse/playback remains available when mic is denied.
frames.persistence: No false grant; denial is rechecked on future explicit use.
frames.talkback: Denied heading → consequence → Try again → Not now.
frames.system: No Android Settings handoff is required for requestable denial.

frames.goal: Reach explicit Android Settings recovery without a loop.
frames.primary: Open Settings; Not now preserves manual use.
frames.entry: Android reports permanent denial or Settings-only recovery.
frames.exit: Open Settings → Android-owned surface; return → three-way recheck.
frames.back: Back/Not now returns to initiating manual surface.
frames.truth: Android permission result after every return.
frames.recovery: Granted, requestable-denied, or still-permanent are separate return outcomes.
frames.persistence: No assumption of Settings success; no auto-loop.
frames.talkback: Permanently denied heading → consequence → Open Settings → Not now → system handoff.
frames.system: [ANDROID / SYSTEM] Settings is a handoff, never an app destination.

frames.goal: See truthful progress while the local derived index is built or reconciled.
frames.primary: Wait; Back/navigation remains available when safe.
frames.entry: First scan, rescan, reconciliation, or verified rebuild.
frames.exit: Empty, Ready, or Recoverable Error.
frames.back: Back leaves the surface without claiming scan cancellation unless supported.
frames.truth: MediaStore existence plus rebuildable local index progress.
frames.recovery: Typed failure routes to Recoverable Error; prior verified state is preserved when possible.
frames.persistence: Index work survives UI recreation; UI progress is not authoritative.
frames.talkback: Library heading → Scanning status/progress → available navigation.
frames.system: Media permission loss hands off to WF-03; no fake Empty state.

frames.goal: Understand that no accessible local tracks are currently indexed.
frames.primary: Rescan; permission recovery appears only when access is actually missing.
frames.entry: Successful scan/reconciliation produces zero accessible tracks.
frames.exit: Ready after content appears, or permission recovery when revoked.
frames.back: Normal app exit/back behavior; state remains truthful on return.
frames.truth: MediaStore projection reconciled through the local index.
frames.recovery: Rescan; no online catalog, recommendations or fabricated results.
frames.persistence: Empty is a valid terminal state and survives recreation until source truth changes.
frames.talkback: Library heading → Empty state → explanation → Rescan.
frames.system: Android Settings is offered only for verified permission recovery.

frames.goal: Browse accessible local music and reach Search or acknowledged playback.
frames.primary: Open a category, Search, or select a track.
frames.entry: Verified non-empty index or returning route with valid current state.
frames.exit: Browse/Search/Full Player/Settings; mini-player opens Full Player.
frames.back: Standard top-level navigation; Back does not stop service-owned playback.
frames.truth: Derived index supplies library; MediaSession supplies mini-player.
frames.recovery: Stale item → reconcile; revoked access → permissions; controller pending stays truthful.
frames.persistence: Playback survives UI recreation; library index is rebuildable.
frames.talkback: Library heading → categories → tracks → mini-player → bottom navigation.
frames.system: No system surface is represented as app navigation.

frames.goal: Retry a local scan/index failure without losing verified state.
frames.primary: Retry scan/reconciliation.
frames.entry: Typed recoverable index, storage or reconciliation failure.
frames.exit: Scanning then Empty/Ready; permission issue routes to WF-03.
frames.back: Back keeps any verified prior library/playback state intact.
frames.truth: Typed repository/index failure plus fresh MediaStore/access check.
frames.recovery: Retry; no reinstall or destructive reset by default.
frames.persistence: Verified prior data is retained; false playability is removed only after authoritative reconciliation.
frames.talkback: Error heading → concise reason → Retry → Back/navigation.
frames.system: Permission recovery is a separate handoff, not embedded Settings UI.

frames.goal: Select a revalidated local result while preserving the active query.
frames.primary: Select a result to request service-owned playback.
frames.entry: Local query returns one or more indexed matches.
frames.exit: Validated selection → Full Player; edit/clear remains in Search.
frames.back: Back returns to Library with no playback mutation.
frames.truth: Local derived-index query; selection revalidated against accessible media.
frames.recovery: Stale result preserves query and reconciles; rejected playback keeps context.
frames.persistence: Query is active-surface state only; no query/result telemetry.
frames.talkback: Search heading → query field → result count → rows → bottom navigation.
frames.system: Typing and result lists are unavailable in active Driving Mode.

frames.goal: Edit or clear a query with no local matches.
frames.primary: Edit query; Clear is secondary.
frames.entry: Local query completes with zero matches.
frames.exit: Updated query → Results/No Result/Error; Back → Library.
frames.back: Preserves no mutation; returns to Library.
frames.truth: Completed local index query; no remote fallback.
frames.recovery: Preserve query and Browse access; subsequent error uses Search Error.
frames.persistence: Query persists only while Search remains active.
frames.talkback: Search heading → query → No results label → Edit/Clear guidance.
frames.system: No online catalog or network handoff.

frames.goal: Recover a local query failure without invalidating a verified library.
frames.primary: Retry; Edit and Clear remain available.
frames.entry: Typed local query/index failure.
frames.exit: Retry → Results/No Result; Back → verified Library.
frames.back: Returns to Library; unrelated playback is unchanged.
frames.truth: Local search repository failure; verified library remains authoritative.
frames.recovery: Retry/edit/clear; use UF-03 only if index truth is actually stale.
frames.persistence: Active query is retained; coarse error only.
frames.talkback: Error heading → concise reason → Retry → Edit/Clear → Back.
frames.system: No network fallback or Android surface.

frames.goal: Control the actual service-owned Playing queue and current item.
frames.primary: Pause; Next/Previous/Seek/Queue remain available as supported.
frames.entry: MediaSessionService acknowledges playback with a valid item.
frames.exit: Back keeps playback; Driving Mode requires explicit entry; Queue remains same authority.
frames.back: Returns to initiating app surface without stopping playback.
frames.truth: MediaSessionService snapshot: item, queue, state, position and supported actions.
frames.recovery: Command/controller failure refreshes actual snapshot; corrupt item uses bounded recovery.
frames.persistence: P0 live service state survives UI recreation.
frames.talkback: Now playing → title/artist → position → Previous → Pause → Next → Queue.
frames.system: Notification/lock/external controls are system-only synchronized surfaces.

frames.goal: Understand the actual Paused state and resume explicitly.
frames.primary: Play.
frames.entry: Service reports Paused after command, interruption or entry.
frames.exit: Acknowledged Play → Playing; Back preserves queue/position.
frames.back: Returns without auto-playing.
frames.truth: MediaSessionService snapshot.
frames.recovery: Controller failure refreshes; interruption route rules may require safe manual resume.
frames.persistence: Active service retains queue/position; UI is observer only.
frames.talkback: Paused state → title/artist → position → Previous → Play → Next → Queue.
frames.system: No optimistic resume after route/focus changes.

frames.goal: Recover from an inaccessible item without looping or deleting media.
frames.primary: Continue with bounded next-item validation; Library is always reachable.
frames.entry: Prepare/advance/selection meets corrupt or inaccessible media.
frames.exit: Valid next → Playing/Paused; none → terminal Paused/Completed or Library.
frames.back: Returns to Library/manual selection; no file deletion.
frames.truth: Typed service failure plus MediaStore/index reconciliation.
frames.recovery: One bounded forward skip; permission/reindex recovery when appropriate.
frames.persistence: False playability is removed; user media is untouched.
frames.talkback: Unavailable heading → concise explanation → Continue → Library.
frames.system: No system dialog unless a separately verified permission recovery is needed.

frames.goal: Control current playback with one stable layer and minimal glance time.
frames.primary: Pause; four large controls, Mic and Exit remain fixed.
frames.entry: Explicit Driving Mode entry with a complete Playing snapshot.
frames.exit: Exit is immediate; Mic opens an overlay, not a new destination.
frames.back: Back behaves as Exit and returns to the prior non-driving surface.
frames.truth: Complete MediaSessionService snapshot and supported actions.
frames.recovery: Pending/rejected commands refresh actual state; route events hand off to UF-11.
frames.persistence: UI owns no player state; Driving Mode is not auto-entered.
frames.talkback: Playing → title/artist → Previous → Pause → Next → Seek back → Mic → Exit.
frames.system: Calls/focus/routes are system events reflected through service truth.

frames.goal: Resume only through an explicit acknowledged Play action.
frames.primary: Play; Exit remains prominent.
frames.entry: Complete snapshot reports Paused/Ended.
frames.exit: Acknowledged Play → Playing; Exit → prior surface.
frames.back: Back equals immediate Exit; never auto-resumes.
frames.truth: MediaSessionService Paused snapshot.
frames.recovery: Unsafe route remains safely Paused; refresh/reconnect never surprises with audio.
frames.persistence: No auto-play on entry or recreation.
frames.talkback: Paused → title/artist → Previous → Play → Next → Seek back → Mic → Exit.
frames.system: Route/focus safety may disable Play with a textual reason.

frames.goal: Leave or start at most one revalidated last local item without opening a list.
frames.primary: Exit; Play last is shown only when a valid local reference exists.
frames.entry: Complete snapshot has no current playable item.
frames.exit: Valid Play last → Playing/Paused; Exit → Home/Library.
frames.back: Back equals Exit.
frames.truth: Service snapshot plus at most one revalidated MediaStore item.
frames.recovery: Failure remains No Track and routes to Library after Exit; no list/typing.
frames.persistence: Only an already-approved local last-item reference may be considered.
frames.talkback: No track heading → explanation → optional Play last → Mic → Exit.
frames.system: No Android Auto, picker or system list is introduced.

frames.goal: Provide one explicit six-second listening attempt while manual/Exit remains reachable.
frames.primary: Cancel.
frames.entry: Explicit microphone tap after permission/provider capability passes.
frames.exit: Result → Processing; failure → Failed/Retry; Cancel → initiating surface.
frames.back: Back equals Cancel and releases capture/duck.
frames.truth: Voice coordinator transient session; playback remains service-owned.
frames.recovery: Timeout/no-match/provider failure preserves playback and exposes one Retry.
frames.persistence: Raw audio/transcript and attempt state are not persisted.
frames.talkback: Listening status → time limit → Cancel → underlying manual/Exit controls.
frames.system: Android mic indicator/dialog is system-owned; capture never starts on mode entry.

frames.goal: Wait for deterministic mapping without a second command or guessed result.
frames.primary: Cancel/manual fallback.
frames.entry: STT result arrives and capture ends.
frames.exit: Certain → command pending/executed; ambiguous → Confirming; failure → Failed/Retry.
frames.back: Back cancels stale callbacks and returns immediately.
frames.truth: Restricted mapper supports exactly six intents; service not yet mutated.
frames.recovery: Unknown/unsupported/not-found becomes safe failure, never approximation.
frames.persistence: No transcript or exact confidence telemetry.
frames.talkback: Processing status → Cancel → underlying Exit/manual controls.
frames.system: Provider processing boundary follows approved disclosure/consent.

frames.goal: Select one immutable presented candidate or reject it.
frames.primary: Choose one of at most two large options; Neither/Cancel is reachable.
frames.entry: Deterministic resolver returns one low-confidence candidate or two artists.
frames.exit: Presented selection → single command pending; reject/timeout → safe failure/manual.
frames.back: Back equals Cancel; no execution.
frames.truth: Immutable session candidate set.
frames.recovery: One bounded question; never keyboard, long list or guessed execution.
frames.persistence: Candidates and names are not telemetry/evidence.
frames.talkback: Prompt → candidate 1 → candidate 2 when present → Neither → Cancel.
frames.system: No new permission or system destination.

frames.goal: Confirm exactly one acknowledged command using refreshed playback truth.
frames.primary: Dismiss/return to manual controls.
frames.entry: Playback service acknowledges the submitted direct/confirmed command.
frames.exit: Returns to the initiating surface with actual refreshed state.
frames.back: Back dismisses; it does not undo acknowledged playback.
frames.truth: MediaSession refresh; optional TTS is non-authoritative.
frames.recovery: TTS failure remains Executed; stale/rejected command uses Failed.
frames.persistence: Only service playback state persists; no transcript.
frames.talkback: Executed status → short result → Dismiss/manual controls.
frames.system: No system surface is created.

frames.goal: Retry once after the first settled failure, then return to immediate manual control.
frames.primary: Retry once; Manual/Cancel remains available.
frames.entry: Timeout/no-match/provider/language/network/audio or execution rejection.
frames.exit: Retry → second Listening; dismiss/manual → initiating surface; second failure is terminal.
frames.back: Back returns immediately and exhausts no hidden action.
frames.truth: Typed Voice/session failure; actual playback remains service-owned.
frames.recovery: Exactly one explicit Retry; no auto-capture, coercive countdown or third attempt.
frames.persistence: Retry budget is ephemeral; coarse failure only.
frames.talkback: Failed heading → short reason → Retry once → Manual → Cancel/Exit.
frames.system: Settings recovery is available only outside active Driving Mode.

frames.goal: Understand that the reconciled local liked projection is empty.
frames.primary: Back to Library; no invented recommendations.
frames.entry: P2 entry load completes with zero accessible liked tracks.
frames.exit: Back; future acknowledged Like can produce Ready.
frames.back: Returns to initiating surface.
frames.truth: Local user-state repository projected through accessible MediaStore items.
frames.recovery: Load/reconcile failure exposes Retry/Back; missing media is reconciled without file mutation.
frames.persistence: Empty is a valid P2 terminal state.
frames.talkback: P2/Removable label → heading → Empty explanation → Back.
frames.system: No P0/P1 dependency; feature can be removed without placeholder.

frames.goal: Play or unlike accessible locally liked tracks.
frames.primary: Play list or select a row; unlike preserves media files.
frames.entry: P2 projection contains accessible liked tracks.
frames.exit: Playback acknowledgement → Full Player; Back → Library.
frames.back: Returns without stopping unrelated playback.
frames.truth: Local Like repository plus accessible MediaStore projection; service owns playback.
frames.recovery: Stale/rejected item refreshes projection; load failure preserves manual playback.
frames.persistence: Acknowledged likes persist locally; missing media reference is cleaned, media untouched.
frames.talkback: P2/Removable label → Play list → rows → Like state/action → Back.
frames.system: Feature remains optional/removable and never blocks P0/P1.

frames.goal: Inspect current truthful preferences, permissions and privacy controls outside Driving Mode.
frames.primary: Open one settings section.
frames.entry: Settings opened from non-driving navigation.
frames.exit: Section/update/handoff; Back returns to prior surface.
frames.back: Returns without changing values or playback.
frames.truth: Preferences plus fresh platform/provider truth.
frames.recovery: Load/update error retains previous value and exposes Retry where safe.
frames.persistence: Only approved local settings/consent are stored.
frames.talkback: Settings heading → section headings → current values/actions → bottom navigation.
frames.system: Android Settings handoff is explicit and never launched from active Driving Mode.

frames.goal: Save or remove an eligible Bluetooth suggestion preference without auto-entering Driving Mode.
frames.primary: Save selection; Remove is explicit.
frames.entry: P1 Bluetooth setup selected outside Driving Mode.
frames.exit: Acknowledged update → Settings; failure retains previous value.
frames.back: Cancels unsaved changes.
frames.truth: Eligible platform devices plus locally stored selected preference.
frames.recovery: Permission/unavailable routes to explicit outside-driving recovery; failure is textual.
frames.persistence: Selected identity stays local and is excluded from telemetry.
frames.talkback: P1 label → Bluetooth heading → selected device → Save/Remove → result.
frames.system: Connection alone never launches Driving Mode; platform identity remains protected.

frames.goal: Confirm only explicitly selected local categories while preserving protected data.
frames.primary: Confirm clear; Cancel is equally reachable.
frames.entry: At least one non-preselected clear category is selected.
frames.exit: Confirm → Clearing/Result; Cancel → selection or Settings.
frames.back: Back equals Cancel; no deletion occurs.
frames.truth: Selected local categories and documented provider boundaries.
frames.recovery: No destructive default; partial/provider failure is reported truthfully later.
frames.persistence: No deletion before confirmation; playback and user media are protected.
frames.talkback: Warning heading → selected categories → preserved categories → Confirm clear → Cancel.
frames.system: Never claims remote deletion unless the provider confirms it.

frames.goal: See per-category cleared, partial or failed results and understand privacy ownership.
frames.primary: Done; Retry only a failed boundary.
frames.entry: Clear plan settles or Privacy details is opened after result.
frames.exit: Done → Settings; Retry → failed boundary only.
frames.back: Returns to Settings without repeating deletion.
frames.truth: Per-boundary repository/provider result; unresolved work remains explicit.
frames.recovery: Partial/failed results never claim success; protected media/playback remains unaffected.
frames.persistence: Cleared local categories are removed; unresolved status remains until retried/dismissed.
frames.talkback: Privacy/result heading → each category status → protected data note → Retry failed → Done.
frames.system: Remote/provider result is distinguished from local deletion.
